title: In a read-only Codex child, `Get-ChildItem Env:` fails with "An item with the same key has already been added", suspect a case-variant duplicate in the child's environment block
outcome: In a read-only Codex child, `Get-ChildItem Env:` fails with "An item with the same key has already been added", suspect a case-variant duplicate in the child's environment block
acceptance: Identify the duplicated variable name pair in a delegated Codex child's environment on Windows (the exact names, and which layer adds each: TermAl spawn, Codex app-server, or the shell tool).

If TermAl's spawn adds the duplicate: TermAl deduplicates the environment case-insensitively before spawn on Windows, keeping one deterministic value, and a test pins it. If another layer adds it: the item records that layer with evidence and is handed to its owner.
`Get-ChildItem Env:ENGRAM*` succeeds in a fresh delegated Codex reviewer on Windows.
